finding.guards_checked: https:// prefix check (EmbedStartParser:34); document-level-only restriction (EmbedProcessor:45); allowlist (EmbedExtension:38-41) absent by default. No private-IP or redirect blocking in this repo; the external embed/embed library is not vendored, so its own SSRF protections are unverified.

finding.claim: The domain allowlist uses suffix matching, so allowlisting a shared apex domain (e.g. github.io) admits any attacker-controlled subdomain, and the embed HTML fetched from it is attacker-influenced and rendered unescaped.
finding.source: Attacker-chosen host under an allowlisted apex domain in Markdown embed URL
finding.guards_checked: Scheme must be http/https (DomainFilteringAdapter:47-48); host lowercased and trailing dot stripped (:52). Parser-differential via backslash checked and ruled out: UrlEncoder.php:26 encodes backslash as %5C. Severity depends on operator choosing a shared apex domain as an allowlist entry.

finding.claim: Default configuration (html_input=allow, allow_unsafe_links=true) passes raw HTML and javascript: link destinations through to output, so untrusted Markdown rendered with defaults is an XSS vector. This is documented default behavior, not a parser bug.
finding.source: Untrusted Markdown: raw HTML blocks or [x](javascript:...) links
